digest.en: The Houthis in Yemen and potential El Niño deaths dominate headlines. Trump's foreign policy pronouncements on the UK, Iran, and Zelenskyy also command attention. Global leaders debate the UN's role against a backdrop of AI concerns.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर दुनिया की अगुवाई है, सुबह-सुबह चेहरा दिखता है डल? ये 7 आसान फेस योगा एक्सरसाइज आएंगी काम मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही एशिया-प्रशांत से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Time to recognize the Houthis as Yemen’s real government
articles.summary: The Trump administration came perilously close to launching another bombing campaign against Yemen this weekend. According to a September 20 New York Times report, US commanders had approved their targets, American troops were loading bombs onto warplanes, and an attack on Yemen’s Ansar Allah forces was about to begin when President Donald Trump abruptly reversed course.

articles.title: This year’s El Niño-driven heat could cause nearly half a million more deaths, group says
articles.summary: The heaviest toll is expected in poorer countries, already struggling with food insecurity and high energy costs, partly due to climate change and the fallout of the war in Iran, the University of Chicago-based Climate Impact Lab says This year’s El Niño-driven heat could cause nearly half a million more deaths, group says.

articles.title: Trump praises new British PM Andy Burnham but slams U.K. deal on Indian Ocean islands
articles.summary: Despite U. K. nerves about how new PM Andy Burnham’s meeting with the U. S. President would go, as they sat in front of U. and U. flags, Mr. Trump declared that trans-Atlantic relations were “more up than they were with your last Prime Minister” Trump praises new British PM Andy Burnham but slams U. deal on Indian Ocean islands.

articles.title: Trump tells CNN at UN as standoff with media outlets persists
articles.summary: The tense moment was a stark reminder of how dramatically the bitter conflict between U. S. President Donald Trump and news outlets whose coverage he objects to as “fake news" has escalated in just a few days Trump tells CNN at UN as standoff with media outlets persists.

articles.title: Macron urges world to choose UN over ‘law of the jungle’
articles.summary: ‘What is our credibility worth if we remain inactive on Gaza; some claim that peace has been achieved, but this has not opened up humanitarian deliveries; it is a spectacle that shames us all,’ said Emmanuel Macron Macron urges world to choose UN over ‘law of the jungle’.

articles.title: Jamaica hails King’s decision to refer slavery reparations petition to privy council as ‘really big
articles.summary: The move comes after Jamaica’s culture minister Olivia Grange travelled to the UK earlier this month to lodge the historic petitionKing Charles has referred a landmark slavery reparations petition from Jamaica to a high-level UK appeals court for legal advice, Jamaica’s culture minister announced in parliament on Tuesday. Jamaica hails King’s decision to refer slavery reparations petition to privy council as ‘really big.

articles.title: Trump, Zelenskyy Discuss Peace Negotiations, Potential Energy Cease-Fire
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. Trump said he believes that both sides "want to see the war end." Zelenskyy said Ukraine is pushing for an agreement with Russia on halting attacks on energy infrastructure. Trump, Zelenskyy Discuss Peace Negotiations, Potential Energy Cease-Fire.

articles.title: Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him
articles.summary: US president may have upstaged the ghost of Soviet leader Khrushchev by musing destruction of fellow member stateDonald Trump has a habit of discomfiting delegates to the United Nations general assembly. But this year, he may have upstaged the ghost of former Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev by openly contemplating the annihilation of a fellow UN member state. Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him.

articles.title: Why Saudi Arabia’s Oil Is Getting Harder To Ship
articles.summary: The crises in the Middle East are creating a growing challenge for Saudi Arabia: how it gets its oil to global markets. Shipping costs are rising, oil has topped $105 a barrel, and global inventories are being rapidly drained. Why Saudi Arabia’s Oil Is Getting Harder To Ship.

articles.title: Children demand a voice on AI’s future
articles.summary: The first generation to grow up with AI may also be the last one anyone thinks to ask about it – and that has to change, the UN's top human rights official said on Tuesday. Children demand a voice on AI’s future.

articles.title: UN rendered unable to fulfil its mission, Turkish President laments before world leaders
articles.summary: The United Nations continues to be weakened, and those who have tied their hopes to the world body – from Palestine to Sudan – have been disappointed, Türkiye’s President said, while adding that his country is committed to restoring confidence in the Organization. UN rendered unable to fulfil its mission, Turkish President laments before world leaders.

articles.title: Trump defends military action against Iran, Venezuela, and calls for rebrand of AI
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump used his address to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday to defend recent military action against Iran, urging countries to maintain economic pressure on Tehran – and declaring that he now faces a choice between making a deal, or taking far more drastic steps. Trump defends military action against Iran, Venezuela, and calls for rebrand of AI.

articles.title: Diplomacy is the way to address global challenges, Brazil tells General Assembly
articles.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva told the General Assembly on Tuesday that the UN needs to become a “temple of peace” once again, as it confronts one of the most critical periods in its 80-year history. Diplomacy is the way to address global challenges, Brazil tells General Assembly.

articles.title: Time to accept ‘hard truths’ so trust can be rebuilt: General Assembly President
articles.summary: The UN’s survival for 80 years is not, by itself, proof of success, and now, the institution must confront painful truths if it hopes to rebuild public trust, said Khalilur Rahman, president of the General Assembly’s 81st session on Tuesday. Time to accept ‘hard truths’ so trust can be rebuilt: General Assembly president.

articles.title: ‘Cracks have become canyons’ as world faces four tests of power
articles.summary: Humanity faces four defining “tests of power” – around war or peace, inequality, climate change and AI – that will determine whether the world moves towards a new era of cooperation or deeper division, the UN chief warned the General Assembly on Tuesday. ‘Cracks have become canyons’ as world faces four tests of power.

articles.title: Millions of children return to schools that still can’t provide clean water or a working toilet
articles.summary: A new academic year is underway in many countries across the world, yet millions of children still attend schools where the water is unsafe to drink, toilets are unusable and there is nowhere to properly wash their hands. Millions of children return to schools that still can’t provide clean water or a working toilet.

articles.title: Cambodia’s anti-scam summit can’t whitewash its own record
articles.summary: This week, Cambodia welcomes foreign diplomats, law-enforcement officials and financial regulators to Phnom Penh for the “International Conference on Combating Online Scams.” Prime Minister Hun Manet’s administration is presenting the gathering as proof that it is ready to confront a criminal trade that has ruined lives across the globe. Yet the official messaging also reveals [] The post Cambodi Cambodia’s anti-scam summit can’t whitewash its own record.

articles.title: Former RFE/RL Journalist Reza Valizadeh Marks Two Years In Iranian Prison
articles.summary: Reza Valizadeh, a former journalist for RFE/RL's Radio Farda, has been incarcerated in Tehran's Evin prison for two years. The dual US-Iranian citizen is serving a 10-year sentence for “collaborating with a hostile government,” a conviction his supporters and press-freedom groups reject. Former RFE/RL Journalist Reza Valizadeh Marks Two Years In Iranian Prison.

articles.title: At least four people killed in Japan as typhoon Dujuan triggers heavy rain, landslides
articles.summary: Rescuers search for missing in collapsed homes after storm causes landslides, travel chaos and power outagesTyphoon Dujuan has killed at least four people and injured 22 in Japan, while tens of thousands of houses near Tokyo remained without power after the storm swept through the region, authorities said on Tuesday. At least four people killed in Japan as typhoon Dujuan triggers heavy rain, landslides.

articles.title: British Columbia sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over Tumbler Ridge mass school shooting
articles.summary: Canadian province alleges deadly attack could have been prevented if company had warned police of shooter’s ChatGPT useBritish Columbia has sued OpenAI in California, saying a mass shooting at a school in the province could have been prevented if the company had warned local ⁠law enforcement that the shooter ⁠had used ChatGPT to ​plan the massacre. British Columbia sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over Tumbler Ridge mass school shooting.

articles.title: Forging an American strategy for China
articles.summary: This article first appeared on Pacific Forum and is republished with kind permission. Read the original here. The US-China relationship stands at a perilous threshold, defined by military friction, accelerating technological competition, and shrinking margins for miscalculation. As Washington debates how to navigate Beijing’s ascent, American strategy should realign its ambitions with realities. W Forging an American strategy for China.

articles.title: Colombia declares public calamity as wildfire threatens popular tourist area
articles.summary: Wildfire forces evacuations and burns through mountains surrounding Villa de Leyva in the north-east Colombian authorities declared a public calamity as a wildfire burned through mountains surrounding one of the country’s best-known colonial towns in the north-east, scorching large swaths of vegetation and forcing evacuations. Nearly 20 active fires are burning across the South American country. Dr Colombia declares public calamity as wildfire threatens popular tourist area.

articles.title: Drones And Desolation: The Long Road To Donetsk's Bilozerske
articles.summary: RFE/RL’s Ukrainian Service correspondent Maryan Kushnir walked some 20 kilometers to reach the embattled city of Bilozerske, in Ukraine’s Donetsk region, which soldiers say has been effectively destroyed by Russian strikes over the past year. Drones And Desolation: The Long Road To Donetsk's Bilozerske.

articles.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
articles.summary: After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millionsNo one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane whe.

articles.title: Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting
articles.summary: There was no let up in fighting between Russia and Ukraine on September 20, as voters in Russia cast ballots on the final day of parliamentary elections from which a political party calling for peace was excluded. Russia's Parliamentary Vote Ends As Moscow, Kyiv Continue Fighting.

articles.title: क्या मजबूरी होगी? दुश्मन की मेजबानी को तैयार हैं ट्रंप, पर जिनपिंग को चुभ जाएगी ठहाकों की ये तस्वीर
articles.summary: Xi Jinping US Visit: चीनी राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग की मेजबानी अमेरिकी प्रेसिडेंट डोनाल्ड ट्रंप करने वाले हैं. ये यात्रा अपने आपमें खास है क्योंकि किसी ने सोचा भी नहीं होगा कि ट्रंप जिसे खुले मंच से दुश्मन कह चुके हैं, उसका न सिर्फ रेड कार्पेट वेलकम करेंगे बल्कि प्रोटोकॉल तोड़कर एयरपोर्ट लेने भी जाएंगे. हालांकि इस मिठास में खटास डालने वाली है अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति और जापान के पीएम की इससे ठीक पहले हुई मी।
